## CleanSpark Executives to Discuss Q4 and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial and Operating Results Via Webcast


November 19, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/978676932/files/doc_news/CleanSpark-Executives-to-Discuss-Q4-and-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-and-Operating-Results-Via-Webcast-2026.pdf)


LAS VEGAS


, Nov. 19, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- CleanSpark, Inc. (Nasdaq: CLSK) ("CleanSpark" or the "Company"), a market leading data center developer **,** will discuss its fiscal fourth quarter and full year 2026 financial and operating results via a live webcast beginning at 4:30 p.m. ET / 1:30 p.m. PT on Tuesday, November 24, 2026.


**Webcast Information:** To view the webcast, please[click here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4825454-1&h=1931652882&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F648799818&a=click+here) .


Downloadable files, including a transcript, will be available on the company website 48 hours after the event.


**About CleanSpark**
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of up 2.1 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin


, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.
